name: Atuin
summary: SQLite-backed shell history with a fuzzy Ctrl-R/Up search UI, per-directory/session/host filters, optional end-to-end-encrypted sync and a background daemon.
configFormat: toml (~/.atuin/config.toml in current docs; older installs ~/.config/atuin/config.toml)
startupCostMs: One `atuin init <shell>` process at shell start (10-60 ms on Windows, measured range for any extra process on this machine) plus a process per recorded command (preexec/precmd) unless the daemon is enabled, which makes history writes instant. Search UI opens on demand.

install.notes: Verified on this machine: Atuinsh.Atuin 18.25.1 (note the capitalisation; `atuinsh.atuin` as an exact id does not match).

windows.notes: Docs recommend WinGet and PowerShell: append `atuin init powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression` to $PROFILE. Try the `default-powershell` theme. bash/zsh init lines are documented for Unix; Atuin on Git Bash is not covered by the Windows instructions (unverified). Daemon uses a TCP port (tcp_port 8889) on non-Unix systems. The tmux popup and pty-proxy features are not available in PowerShell.

macos.notes: Daemon autostart runs as a launchd agent (~/Library/LaunchAgents/sh.atuin.daemon.plist). MacPorts: port install atuin.

install.notes: Debian only, and old (trixie 18.6.1); prefer the installer script.

linux.notes: Installer: `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://setup.atuin.sh | sh` (installs to ~/.atuin/bin and wires the shell). Older installs keep data in ~/.config/atuin and ~/.local/share/atuin; Atuin keeps using them if ~/.atuin is absent. ATUIN_HOME / ATUIN_CONFIG_DIR override locations.

suggestions.notes: Interactive search, not inline ghost-text suggestions.

highlighting.notes: Only syntax-highlights commands inside its search results (ui.syntax_highlight); not the command line you type.

sources: winget show --id Atuinsh.Atuin; scoop search atuin (machine, 2026-11-23)
